description: Expected behavior on fixtures/input.json, checked by scripts/test-github-dependency-issue-risk-alerts.mjs and by QA in the private instance.

1000.summary: Version 2.4.0 crashes on empty JSON request bodies that worked in 2.3.2.

1001.summary: Crafted query strings can pollute Object.prototype in 2.x.

1002.summary: Typo in the retries guide; no code impact.

1003.summary: Trailing-slash matching stopped working after upgrading from 5.0.3 to 5.1.0.

1005.summary: User asks how to return JSON errors.

1006.summary: CLI exits 0 without a config file, so CI can pass silently.

1007.summary: 3.0 switched the default output to JSON and breaks scripts that parse text.

1008.summary: Path test is flaky on Windows runners.

assertions: Node 1 settings become one Actor input per repository (owner/name, URL and .git forms normalized), with since = today minus lookbackDays, maxItems per repository, issues only and no labels or token by default.
Missing or malformed repositories stop the run before any paid request with a readable error.
Happy path: all 9 synthetic issues are new, numbered for the AI and sorted by updatedAt.
Duplicate run: every issue is already in the sheet with the same updatedAt, so Issues to Score? is false and nothing is written to Sheets or Slack.
An issue updated since it was logged is rescored; its earlier Slack alert is remembered and not repeated.
Empty Actor datasets: readable 'No issues were updated' message and no destination writes.
One failed repository is listed and the others continue; when every run fails (for example a missing Apify credential) the run stops with a readable error and writes nothing.
Sheet rows carry exactly the 16 headers of the Dependency Issues tab and are upserted on url.
Malformed, empty, out-of-range or unrelated OpenAI output: AI Scores Valid? is false, readable message, no destination writes.
Slack digest lists only issues at riskScore 4 or higher that were not alerted before (1000, 1001, 1003, 1007); a quiet day ends at Quiet Day - No Slack Post.
